messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT ALERT - High 5xx rate on dedicated inference pool in eu-west-1. Triggering paging for on-call. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-5xx
maya.gupta: Ack. I'm taking lead — will triage connectivity + routing rules. Paging @tim.oncall
tim.oncall: On it. collecting logs now, attaching the initial error sample to the incident channel.
alex.jones: Seeing a surge of backend 502s from the pool — looks like a kernel OOM on a subset of nodes. Scaling not recovering.
maya.gupta: Can we isolate affected hosts and drain? ops-lead, can we schedule immediate instance drains for the failing hosts?
ops-lead: Starting drain sequence for node-group eu-west-1-dedicated-3. Will throttle to avoid cold-start spike. ETA ~6m.
emma.csm: Heads up — Horizon Health (enterprise) is reporting degraded inference. They have a dedicated contract and strict SLA. Need tailored customer comms for their ops and CSMs.
maya.gupta: Drafting tailored notification for Horizon Health now. Will post below for review. Please respond with quick approvals (@legal if any phrasing concerns).
maya.gupta: DRAFT CUSTOMER NOTE (Horizon Health):
```
Subject: Service Degradation - Dedicated Inference (eu-west-1) — Immediate Update
Hi Horizon Ops Team,
We're currently investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting your dedicated inference capacity in eu-west-1. Symptoms: requests to /v1/infer are returning 502/503; throughput is impacted. Scope: Horizon Health account (HORIZON-001), all dedicated nodes in pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3. Estimated customer impact: increased error rates for ~100% of requests to the dedicated endpoint; some retries may succeed via fallback routing but overall latency and error ratio are elevated.
What we're doing: on-call engineering is isolating failing nodes, draining affected GPUs, and applying a kernel memory patch to prevent OOMs. We're prioritizing your traffic on surviving hosts and enabling temporary spillover to our regional shared-capacity in eu-west-1 to reduce errors.
Next updates: we will post a status update in 15 minutes or sooner if mitigations complete. Expected mitigation window: 15–45 minutes (dependent on successful node drain and warm-up).
If you need dedicated escalation, contact: amanda.csm@redwood.ai, +1-415-555-0187. For SRE escalation, reply to this thread or call on-call at +1-415-555-0100.
Apologies for the disruption — we're treating this with highest urgency.
Regards,
Redwood Inference — Incident Response Team
```
maya.gupta: internal note: This includes a spillover to shared pool — need legal eyes? @legal
legal: Quick read — phrasing OK. Suggest removing "kernel memory patch" detail in external note to avoid low-level ops disclosure. Recommend "applying targeted fixes to affected hosts" instead.
maya.gupta: Updated line per legal: "applying targeted fixes to affected hosts". Thanks.
ops-lead: Drain finished on 3/5 hosts; two more draining now. Error rate dropped ~30% so far. Continuing.
tim.oncall: Rolling the hotfix to one host for verification. If stable for 2 cycles we'll roll to remainder.
alex.jones: Confirming fallback routing to shared-capacity is active for Horizon traffic — rate-limited to avoid noisy neighbor. Latency slightly increased but errors down for a subset.
emma.csm: Notifying Horizon Ps: sending the edited external note and scheduling a call for account escalation. Will paste the CSM-facing message here before sending.
emma.csm: CSM MESSAGE (to Horizon execs):
"We're actively mitigating a service degradation impacting your dedicated inference capacity. We've prioritized your requests on healthy hosts and enabled temporary spillover to maintain availability. An engineering fix is being rolled and we'll provide the next update in 15 minutes. Amanda (CSM) is on call for your team: amanda.csm@redwood.ai."
maya.gupta: Proposed status page update (short):
```
Status: Investigating
Components: Dedicated inference (eu-west-1)
Impact: Elevated 5xx rates for some dedicated customers (Horizon Health impacted). We are isolating affected hosts and applying fixes; temporary spillover to shared capacity is enabled to reduce errors.
Next update: in 15 minutes.
```
ops-lead: Ready to post once legal final signoff — legal already gave greenlight on wording.
maya.gupta: Posting status page and sending customer note (emma will send to Horizon). Also tagging #support to prep templates. :thumbsup:
emma.csm: Sent to Horizon ops + execs, requested a 1:1 update call in 10 min. They acknowledged and requested SLA credit process details; forwarding to billing team.
alex.jones: Monitoring shows error rate down 65% after second host roll. Still validating mem stability.
tim.oncall: If host stays stable for next 10m, will complete hotfix roll and then mark the incident as mitigated.
maya.gupta: Great. Keep this thread updated with any customer escalation or change in scope. I'll prepare the post-incident account impact summary for Horizon with token counts, failed request counts, and proposed SLA credit calc after mitigation.
ops-lead: Noted — I'll export node-level logs and attach to the incident record for the postmortem.
sre-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation in progress — dedicated-drain completed for 3/5 hosts, fallback routing active. Next update at 1757773433.
